title: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel
summary: Moves revised equality and freedom clauses, including public-employment equality, representation safeguards and the architecture of restricted liberties.

title: Somnath Lahiri
summary: Continues challenging restrictions on civil liberty and presses stronger protections around press freedom, detention and social-economic transformation.

title: K. M. Munshi
summary: Presents the interim constitution-making programme and moves the creation of Union and Provincial Constitution committees.

title: C. M. Poonacha
summary: Asks that the proposed constitutional committees explicitly examine the position of Chief Commissioners' provinces and public opinion in those areas.

title: B. Pattabhi Sitaramayya
summary: Welcomes the two constitutional committees and points to questions such as linguistic redistribution that may need to be considered within the emerging Union and provincial framework.
